description: UK map packs The First Book knows about. Nothing here is downloaded by the app: fetch or build a pack by hand while online, drop the file into library/maps/ under the filename given, and it is served from disk. Sizes are not pinned because extracts change; check the source page.

packs.title: Demo: UK overview (Protomaps, zoom 0-8)
packs.how_to_get: scripts/fetch_demo_map.sh (pmtiles extract of the daily build, UK bbox, --maxzoom=8).

packs.title: Demo: Bristol and Bath (Protomaps, zoom 0-15)
packs.how_to_get: scripts/fetch_demo_map.sh (pmtiles extract of the daily build, --bbox=-2.75,51.38,-2.45,51.56 --maxzoom=15).

packs.title: UK basemap (Protomaps, vector)
packs.how_to_get: Install the pmtiles CLI (https://github.com/protomaps/go-pmtiles), then extract the UK from a daily planet build: pmtiles extract https://build.protomaps.com/<YYYYMMDD>.pmtiles uk.pmtiles --bbox=-8.65,49.86,1.77,60.86 --maxzoom=14 . Lower --maxzoom (e.g. 12) for a much smaller file; a county-sized --bbox is handy for testing.
packs.viewer: MapLibre GL JS + pmtiles.js, vendored under static/vendor/, shown on /maps

packs.title: UK OpenStreetMap vector tiles (MBTiles, self-built)
packs.how_to_get: Download the Geofabrik united-kingdom-latest.osm.pbf, then build MBTiles with planetiler (OpenMapTiles schema) or tilemaker (https://github.com/systemed/tilemaker). Served by /tiles/uk-osm/{z}/{x}/{y}.
packs.license: ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap data); OpenMapTiles schema is CC-BY 4.0
packs.viewer: MapLibre GL JS, vendored under static/vendor/, shown on /maps

packs.title: OS Open Zoomstack (Ordnance Survey, vector)
packs.how_to_get: Download the 'Vector Tiles (MBTiles)' format from the OS Data Hub (about 2.7 GB, listed as OS_Open_Zoomstack.mbtiles on 19 Nov 2026) and rename it to os-open-zoomstack.mbtiles.
packs.attribution: Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right
packs.viewer: MapLibre GL JS, vendored under static/vendor/, shown on /maps
